minutes.headline: ZBA upheld the ban on short-term rentals at 15 Cliffview Terrace and re-granted a lapsed townhouse permit.
minutes.summary: The board heard two cases. It granted EF Realty's lapsed special permit for townhouses at 711 Massachusetts Avenue, continuing the prior conditions. It then denied the Smolters' appeal of the building commissioner's cease-and-desist on short-term rentals at 15 Cliffview Terrace, and declined their request to honor existing bookings through October.

public_comment.topic: Applicant said he cannot complete the project himself and has a signed offer to sell to a builder; asked for the lapsed permit to be renewed.
Appellants said they bought intending to move in later, registered with the state, saw no bylaw restriction, and asked only to finish existing bookings through October.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit as requested, continuing the conditions from the previous permit.
Deny the person-aggrieved appeal, upholding the building commissioner's letter, and not allow rentals to continue through October.

decisions.decision: Applicant stated language will be included so the special permit does not need to come back again if the property is sold.
Chair announced the building inspector's decision upheld; decision to be filed with the town clerk within 14 days, with 20-day appeal period to Superior Court.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals denied an appeal of the building commissioner's cease-and-desist on short-term rentals at 15 Cliffview Terrace, upholding it.
The board also declined the owners' request to honor existing bookings through October.
The board granted EF Realty's lapsed special permit for townhouses at 711 Massachusetts Avenue, continuing the conditions from the previous permit.
The applicant said language would be included so the permit does not need to return if the property is sold; he has a signed offer from a builder.
The chair said the decision is to be filed with the town clerk within 14 days, followed by a 20-day appeal period to Superior Court.

why_it_matters: For owners and neighbors, the ruling means short-term rentals at a residential address can be stopped by a building commissioner's order even when the state registration exists and the bylaw has no explicit restriction the owners could find.
The townhouse permit keeps a stalled project alive on its old conditions and lets it pass to a new builder, so the approved plan at 711 Massachusetts Avenue carries forward unchanged.
watch_next: The written decision, due to be filed with the town clerk within 14 days, and the 20-day window for appeal to Superior Court that follows.
